classification.difficultyReason: Find graph intersections, compare a V-shaped graph with a horizontal line, and distinguish strict from inclusive boundaries.

answer.worked:
Sketch $y=|x-1|$ and $y=3$. Find their intersections:
$$\begin{align*}|x-1|&=3\\x-1&=3&\text{or}\quad x-1&=-3\\x&=4&\text{or}\quad x&=-2\end{align*}$$
The V-shaped graph is above $y=3$ when $x<-2$ or $x>4$. Exclude both intersections.

spec.mathematics: y=|x−1| has vertex (1,0); y=3 intersects at (−2,3) and (4,3). Required regions are outside the intersections.

answer.worked:
Sketch $y=|x+2|$ and $y=2$. Find their intersections:
$$\begin{align*}|x+2|&=2\\x+2&=2&\text{or}\quad x+2&=-2\\x&=0&\text{or}\quad x&=-4\end{align*}$$
The V-shaped graph is on or below $y=2$ when $-4\le x\le 0$. Include both intersections.

answer.worked:
Sketch $y=|2x-1|$ and $y=3$. Find their intersections:
$$\begin{align*}|2x-1|&=3\\2x-1&=3&\text{or}\quad 2x-1&=-3\\2x&=4&\text{or}\quad 2x&=-2\\x&=2&\text{or}\quad x&=-1\end{align*}$$
The V-shaped graph is on or above $y=3$ when $x\le -1$ or $x\ge 2$.

Sketch $y=|3x+4|$ and $y=2$. Find their intersections:
$$\begin{align*}|3x+4|&=2\\3x+4&=2&\text{or}\quad 3x+4&=-2\\3x&=-2&\text{or}\quad 3x&=-6\\x&=-\frac23&\text{or}\quad x&=-2\end{align*}$$
The V-shaped graph is below $y=2$ when $-2<x<-\frac23$. Exclude both intersections.
